title: P104 methods: {0}/V re-basis, absorption, range-G pre-loads, signed-row Rado/LU helpers, O+(8,2) blocks, t = −1 callers (no κ)
body:
Package `research/p104-methods` writes down six construction methods from our P104 work. Each method comes with its scope and a standard-library exact checker. The package makes **no κ claim** and ships no new word. It builds on #7542 (helper rung merges), #7555 (structure laws) and #7557 (t = −1 laws), and does not repeat them.

Tags in the README: [P] proved in PROOF.md, [C] exact run in this package, [Q] lane number quoted but not reproduced here, open.

1. **{0}/V re-basis** (`rebasis.py`). This is an exact test for deleting a paid helper rung while every row stays fixed. It has two parts, both proved [P]:
   - {0} freedom: registers leaving {0} admit exactly the unitriangular mixing.
   - V freedom: V-arrival rows only need to lie in W_V.

   Combined with local slots, the test found 761@1053, the 761 half of #7542. The checker rebuilds that merge from Clear1nsight's #7334 word (vendored with the same SHA256 as in #7542) and replays it exactly. All 1,569 rows and end charts match, and 761 goes from 0→5→7 to 0→7. It also checks the {0} and V facts separately. Seven controls are rejected.
2. **Absorption** (`absorption.py`). A helper is settled against a register's outstanding junk instead of against Y: it lumps −λ·y at {0}, does H += Σd·X_r(K), then H −= Σd·X_r^f at V.
   - It ends clean iff λ = Σ d·ψ_r [P, C].
   - The last-outstanding-cell rule: random absorb time gives D = 3, the rule gives D = 0 [C].
   - Under #7557's σ-anchors, D = 0 on A3/A4, against n − r with all cells settled [C]. This is **frame-free algebra on toys**: no frame legality is checked and E8 is not simulated.
3. **Range-G pre-loads** (`preload.py`). A span law shows that range-G y content is not excluded at any chart [P]. The owned gauge G·(x/2 + (11/2)·y) gives Y_t = x_t with no zero-Y park, exactly on all 104 columns of the PR968 Gram [C]. The charge half (carrier tokens) is open.
4. **Signed-row helpers, Rado/LU** (`rado_lu.py`). Group feasibility is Rado's transversal condition, and it is realised by LU into elementary ADDs.
   - One helper carrying a free signed row fixes a deficit of 2 where a pure e_k helper fails [C].
   - Agrees with brute force on 118 seeded instances [C].
   - The lane's full fan-out build (408.68 vs 1,692.1 D0/call) is quoted, not reproduced [Q].
5. **O+(8,2) quotient** (`quotient.py`). All [C]:
   - The vendored port Gram equals the PR968 Gram up to a verified permutation and ±1 switching.
   - The ports are 104 of the 120 nonsingular points of the quadric.
   - Two-graph sign law: product −1 exactly on the 704 c-sum triples, and one wrong cell per partner pair.
   - 282 twelve-port 4-spaces, plus one packing of 8 port-disjoint blocks.
   - The c-trick identity, and 33 disjoint c-sum triples. Their maximality is not claimed.
6. **t = −1 callers** (`callers.py`).
   - The exact MONOHUB joint caller (A: HOST(−1,1); B: Rohan Arun's #7113 verbatim) replays with bad 0 at q = 1, i, −1, −i for an *idealised* native [C].
   - The 20-odd-op floor for one q-free plane is proved [P, via Lemma E of #7555]. Four callers meet it exactly [C].
   - Form orbit: 3 new lines per J, and the 17 input planes span 34 [C].
   - The 8 even fusions fail [C].
   - No buildable native is claimed.

Not reproduced here, and listed in the README: the general re-basis scan and its bilinear extension, a frame-legal E8 absorption layer, the full fan-out and U-junk builds, a HOST(−1,1) native, and Lemma A.

- Validator: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-methods` → `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`, in about 90 s.
- The branch carries the two #7257 CI-prerequisite commits by Clear1nsight, cherry-picked with authorship kept.
- No human has reviewed the package.
